Name: Rehum
Role: Leader of the Return; Covenant Sealer
Summary: A leader who returned with Zerubbabel — Nehemiah's copy of the list reads Nehum — and later sealed the covenant. A different Rehum from the Persian chancellor.
LifeLesson: Two men can share a name and serve on opposite sides of a wall.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
